premises.text: Security teams cannot easily answer company-wide questions about files, PII exposure, and access locations
premises.evidence_span: a security team has no easy way to answer any of the questions I ask, especially company-wide

premises.text: Users are paid for productivity, so security tools that require human security decisions fail in practice
premises.evidence_span: people are getting paid for productivity, not security

premises.text: Phalanx overlays protection on everyday document actions so unused files stay encrypted without hurting productivity
premises.evidence_span: If you have 1,000 files on your computer and you're only using one, then you expose that one while 999 files are secured by Phalanx

premises.text: Identity-linked encrypted files remain accessible via familiar desktop interactions
premises.evidence_span: They can double-click files, right-click files, everything that they're used to today

premises.text: Visibility map of file access across workspaces supports restriction and feeds existing analytics via API
premises.evidence_span: SysOs can finally see who's accessing what, where, and how across their workspaces

premises.text: Unlike rules-based DLP, identity-based automation deploys in less than a day with no weekly maintenance
premises.evidence_span: we're deployable in less than a day and requires zero weekly maintenance

premises.text: GTM combines scalable per-user mid/large enterprise sales with channel partners for SMBs
premises.evidence_span: we can also deploy out to SMBs via the channel. So we have channel partners that represent tens of thousands of users under management
